title: How Primitive Building Videos Are Staged
summary: A video debunking popular primitive-building YouTube channels, arguing that their digging, concrete and construction are staged. It uses the Primitive Technology channel as a baseline for what is plausible in a natural setting.
why: HN cites it as an exposé of fake primitive-tech copycat channels, usually when the genuine Primitive Technology videos come up.

quote.text: The video hyperlinked below is a fascinating debunking of most other "primitive" channels.
